memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, works full‑time at jewellery shop, manages household chores.
cognition: Mini‑Cog 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal).
falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 0 regular.
mood: reports occasional low mood, denies depression.
carers: Mother, Mrs. Lakshmi – primary support.
goal: "I want to feel less tired and keep up with my work."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin 9.8 g/dL (12‑16), Serum ferritin 12 ng/mL (15‑150), MCV 68 fL (80‑100).
Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D 14 ng/mL (30‑100), Serum calcium 8.9 mg/dL (8.5‑10.5), Serum phosphate 2.8 mg/dL (2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Ferrous sulfate 200 mg PO OD
Cholecalciferol 60000 IU PO once weekly for 8 weeks

memories.author: D06

mood: reports improved energy, mood stable.
carers: Mother, Mrs. Lakshmi – helps with grocery.
goal: "I want my energy to last through the whole workday."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Feeling more fatigued over the past two weeks, especially after work. Concerned that my iron might be dropping again.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Resting ECG: sinus rhythm, rate 78 bpm, no ST‑T changes, normal intervals. No evidence of ischemia.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Dr. S. Rao, Cardiologist, for evaluation of persistent fatigue despite normal labs; request ECG review and possible stress testing.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Cardiologist reports normal ECG and stress test; fatigue likely non‑cardiac. Advises continue current haematinic and vitamin D supplementation, monitor symptoms.
